allometry_identical.quote: The allometric relationship between body size and pectoral fin length was identical across the two- and four-wing flying fishes

allometry_rapid.quote: the length of flying fish pectoral fins increases rapidly

allometry_s1a.quote: Paired fin and standard fish lengths were measured from beloniform specimens in the Harvard Museum of Comparative Zoology (Data S1A)

cap_coverage.quote: We obtained coverage from an average of 78.3% of the targeted genomic regions at an average 38.3-fold depth

cap_species.quote: 35 different beloniform species, including two- and four-winged flying fishes, halfbeaks, sauries, and needlefishes

data_sra.quote: Raw targeted sequencing reads have been deposited in the NCBI Sequence Read Archive

f326l.quote: we detected a shared amino acid substitution in lat4a that is found across multiple lineages having enlarged pectoral fins

f326l_caveat.quote: we cannot exclude incomplete lineage sorting or introgression of ancestral F326L haplotypes specifically within gliding lineages

fig4_mechanism.quote: the mechanism of fin-specific suppression of lof by lat4a mutations is occurring downstream of bioelectric signaling signals

fig4_phenocopy.quote: suggesting the interaction between these two genes is sufficient to phenocopy this key innovation and organismal bauplan of flying fishes

fig4_qrt.quote: kcnh2a expression does not vary significantly in pectoral or dorsal fins containing the nr21 mutation

fig4_suppressor.quote: lat4a is a fin suppressor of overgrowth caused by increased potassium channel function

fig4_title.quote: Intersection of bioelectric and Lat4a-mediated growth pathways is sufficient to phenocopy the evolved flying fish fin allometry

fig4_transhet.quote: the nr21/lof trans-heterozygotes exhibit elongated paired fins and a hypocercal caudal fin

lat4_function.quote: Mammalian Lat4 shuttles isoleucine, leucine, methionine, and phenylalanine into the cell in an ion- and pH-independent manner

lat4_slc43a2_ref.quote: Essential amino acid transporter Lat4 (Slc43a2) is required for mouse development

lat4a_alleles.quote: Lat4a alleles identified and used in this work are lat4nr21 (dmh26), and lat4adel (mh152).

lat4a_grna.quote: CRISPR guide RNAs (gRNAs) were designed against the third coding exon of lat4a

lat4a_map.quote: we mapped nr21 to chromosome 15 and identified a nonsynonymous mutation (T200K) in a conserved domain of the L-type amino acid transporter, lat4a
lat4a_map.what: nr21 mapped to chromosome 15; T200K in lat4a

lat4a_null.quote: zebrafish lacking lat4a have no fin phenotype
lat4a_null.what: lat4a loss of function has no fin phenotype

lat4a_phyloP.quote: Lat4a also has a phyloP acceleration p = 0.008 on the common ancestral node of flying fishes

lof_alleles.quote: Longfin alleles used in this work are lofdt2, the revertants lof (lfr1(Y669N), lfr2(L739Q), and WL7 (Y418X).

lof_breakpoints.quote: identified a breakpoint upstream of the transcription start site of prrx1a (23.174 Mb in Zv11) and one between kcc4a and kcnh2a (24.075 Mb)

lof_cis_ref.quote: longfin causes cis-ectopic expression of the kcnh2a ether-a-go-go K+ channel to autonomously prolong fin outgrowth

lof_deletion_line.quote: The deletion line lofj6e1 (lofDf(Chr02:csnk1g2a,rnf2,kifap3b)j6g1/j6g1) is present at ZIRC repository (ZL1494).

lof_ectopic.quote: As ectopic expression of kcnh2a is sufficient to drive fin overgrowth (Figure 3)

lof_gof.quote: The ability to revert the mutant phenotype by loss-of-function kcnh2a alleles in cis to lof indicates the mutant imparts a gain-of-function effect
lof_gof.what: kcnh2a lof is a gain of function

lof_not_maintained.quote: These lines are no longer maintained nor frozen, thus are used for confirmation of mapping only.
lof_not_maintained.what: lof^dt2 and revertants are not maintained

nr21_body.quote: The nr21 mutant, however, does not have a statistically decreased body size
nr21_body.what: fin effect without a body-size effect

nr21_gof.quote: indicating that the mutation in lat4anr21 results from a gain-of-function effect
nr21_gof.what: cis frameshift reverts nr21: gain of function

nr21_small_fins.quote: We identified a dominant mutant, nr21, as having small adult fins compared to wild-type siblings

sailfin.quote: only one flying fish species in our dataset lacks the convergent lat4a allele, the sailfin flying fish Parexocoetus brachypterus
sailfin.what: exception with an elongated dorsal fin

supp_location.quote: Supplemental information can be found online at https://doi.org/10.1016/j. cub.2021.08.054.
